jobs.description: Job Details: At Tyson Foods, we believe that our team members are the heart of our success. Are you ready to take on a dynamic role where you can make a significant impact? This facility is part of our Prepared Foods business unit. The Controller I will be responsible for the financial planning, analysis and reporting functions of the plant-manufacturing unit. This individual will manage the plant accounting staff performing the local accounting functions including production accounting and payroll. This role will also handle the preparation of the weekly forecast of plant operating variances, set policies, establish guidelines, and lead the budgeting process. A strong understanding of and collaboration with plant operations on continuous improvements activities to improve the total cost of operations will be a part of this role as well. Ensure accuracy in product costs, production costs, and manufacturing variances. Oversee formal and informal financial accounting and payroll systems, including payroll administration and internal controls. Financial Reporting and Forecasting: Provide direction for internal and external financial reporting and forecasting efforts. Supervise reporting and analysis of plant performance, production reporting, and inventory functions. Support new product development and cost reduction efforts through financial analysis and cost estimates. Relationship Management: Maintain and develop business relationships with various departments including headquarters personnel, maintenance, operations, and engineering. Operational Support: Provide credible and thorough financial analysis to support plant operations. Support LEAN and Safety initiatives as appropriate. Planning and Compliance: Lead the preparation of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), Long Range Plan (LRP), and other performance projections. Develop and implement key controls for SOX compliance. Coordinate audits of company accounts and financial transactions to ensure compliance with state and federal requirements. Finance and/or Cost Accounting experience; preferably in the food industry. Experience: 4+ years of supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment with an understanding of standard cost and variance reporting required; within a food manufacturing facility preferred. Communication skills : Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills. Computer skills : Advanced PC skills (SAP, Word, Excel, Access and PowerPoint). Special Skills: Knowledgeable in the areas of GAAP, Cost Accounting, Fixed Assets, General Ledger Accounting, Payroll, and SOX. jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Title and Summary Vice President - Enterprise Value Strategy & Transformation Overview Mastercard is on a journey to embed a common language of value across the enterprise. As Vice President, Value Strategy & Transformation, you will play a leadership role in scaling Mastercard's Value Quantification (MVQ) capability across Services, Core Payments, and Commercial & New Payment Flows (CNPF). Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Value Enablement & Optimization, you will help drive the strategy, execution, governance and adoption of MVQ globally. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, product, pricing, sales, customer success, analytics and technology. You will partner closely with business and functional leaders to translate Mastercard's value vision into scalable capabilities, operating models, and solutions that help teams quantify, communicate, and demonstrate measurable value. The ideal candidate combines strong strategic thinking, program leadership, operational excellence, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive transformation across a highly matrixed global organization. ________________________________________ What You'll Be Accountable For Strategy Execution & Transformation • Partner with senior leadership to execute Mastercard's enterprise value strategy and roadmap. • Help evolve existing value quantification capabilities into a unified Mastercard Value Quantification (MVQ) framework. • Drive strategic initiatives that strengthen how value is measured, communicated, and applied across the business. Cross-Functional Partnership • Collaborate with Product, Pricing, Sales, Customer Solutions Center, Account Management, Customer Success, Finance, and Services teams. • Support embedding MVQ into key commercial, product, and customer engagement processes. • Help build alignment around value measurement standards, methodologies, and best practices. Adoption & Enablement • Develop strategies that drive enterprise adoption of MVQ capabilities. • Lead communications, training, and engagement programs that increase awareness and usage. • Establish success metrics and feedback mechanisms to continually improve user experience and business impact. Platform & Capability Development • Partner with Technology, Analytics, and Product teams to enhance Mastercard's value quantification platform and supporting capabilities. • Drive the development of scalable methodologies, value models, tools, and insights. • Support the integration of new data sources, AI capabilities, and analytical approaches to improve value delivery. Program Leadership & Governance • Lead day-to-day management of the enterprise MVQ program. • Establish governance processes, operating rhythms, and decision-making frameworks that promote alignment and accountability. • Coordinate priorities across multiple functions and business units. • Track progress against strategic objectives and communicate outcomes to senior stakeholders. Team Leadership • Lead and develop a high-performing team focused on value strategy, execution, and capability development. • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. • Coach and mentor team members while building organizational capability in value quantification and value-based decision making. ________________________________________ What You'll Bring • 15+ years of experience in strategy, management consulting, business transformation, commercial excellence, customer value, pricing, analytics, product management or related disciplines. • Demonstrated success leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives within complex global organizations. • Strong strategic thinking, financial acumen, and analytical problem-solving skills. • Experience developing business cases, ROI models, value frameworks, or commercial strategy initiatives. • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across functions and levels. • Experience driving organizational change and adoption of new processes, capabilities, or platforms. • Strong people leadership experience, including building and developing high-performing teams. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description: OVERVIEW Experience a place of energy, passion, and excitement. A place where the joy of discovery and uncommon artistry blend to create exhilarating buying experiences—for true beauty enthusiasts. At Ulta Beauty, we’re transforming the world one shade, one lash, one cut at a time. Because beauty is powerful. If you seek greater purpose —a place of vision, mission, and lived values—where voices are heard, contributions valued and recognized and growth opportunities abound, consider Ulta Beauty. Nowhere else are the possibilities quite this beautiful. GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE The Sales Manager (SM) is responsible for leading through Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values in order to develop a high-performing team that consistently delivers top-line sales growth across all categories. The SM leads a team of Beauty Advisors, Prestige Beauty Advisors, and Lead Cashiers and is accountable for all aspects of the retail business with the exception of boutiques, including sales, service, and operational process. The SM is accountable for Net Promoter Score (NPS) and delivering an exceptional guest experience. This leader drives the business through a focus on performance (NPS, sales and in-store events), people (guest service and associate training), and process (standard operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires a drive for results, a passion for the beauty industry, exceptional guest service, the aptitude to learn and teach extensive product knowledge, and the ability to lead, influence, and develop their team. PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Job Functions) The SM is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned): Performance Promote a culture of accountability to meet or exceed Ulta Beauty’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), payroll, omni-channel, and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty for the store. Drive company profitability by identifying underperforming metrics and developing strategies that leverage company programs, tools, and resources through operational excellence to deliver top-line sales growth and improve business. Leverage store forecast and payroll budgets to support with store scheduling needs and communicate the needs to the GM to maximize productivity, achieve sales and payroll goals, and complete workload on time, and within the payroll budget. Plan and execute in-store events that deliver an unrivaled guest experience, drive in-store and brand partner collaboration, and deliver on sales and payroll goals. Review, analyze and react to Ulta Beauty’s financial and operational reporting, including store visit and audit results, regularly and in a timely manner. Perform makeup applications, skincare analysis, and product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and guest service experience. Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests. Maintain prompt, regular attendance as the SM and hold store associates accountable to the Ulta Beauty attendance policy. People Attract, hire, and retain a diverse team of top talent, and efficiently address any staffing needs and open positions for the store. Build a highly engaged team at the store that embodies the Ulta Beauty brand through effective collaboration, open and honest communication, and prioritization of work. Create an inclusive environment that inspires and encourages the growth and engagement of associates. Support all aspects of associate professional development, including training, providing individualized competency-based feedback and coaching, performance reviews, succession planning, and individual development plans to enable continuous development and drive sales performance. Regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance. Ensure direct reports regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance. Establish professional brand partner relationships that foster a shared interest in collaboratively delivering on sales and service goals. Model a culture of teamwork and guest services excellence while working alongside the leadership team by establishing priorities, providing clear direction and support, and sharing best practices. Execute the Guest Engagement Leader program flawlessly through business ownership, associate coaching and leading a helpful and friendly guest experience to drive business results across all Annual Performance Goals (APGs) metrics for the store. Process Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards for the store. Adhere to and enforce Ulta Beauty’s dress code. Use the company’s scheduling tool as directed to adjust schedules and manage attendance in-the-moment during manager-on-duty shifts to ensure accurate schedules and reporting. Use the company’s task management tool as directed to prioritize and execute store workload, including product and marketing resets, pricing updates, inventory related tasks, cleaning, and replenishment. Protect company assets and minimize loss by ensuring all store standards and operating procedures are met, including workplace safety, inventory control, cash management, and loss prevention. Execute day-to-day inventory control processes (e.g., known theft, damages, hazardous waste, inventory adjustments, product returns) and complete theft reporting as necessary. Support continuous improvement by influencing the adoption of company initiatives and technology, communicating expectations, and ensuring the execution of all store tasks. Utilize company programs, tools, and resources to drive store improvements. Regularly communicate and provide feedback to field leadership on business trends and opportunities, events, operational challenges, merchandise needs, and competitive landscape for their store. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Education Bachelor’s degree is preferred Experience 2-3+ years of fast-paced, retail management, or other relevant work experience Financial management: success with driving top-line sales, interpreting reporting data, managing payroll budgets, and controlling expense Retail management: proven ability with monitoring inventory levels, achieving operational excellence, driving a service culture, and executing merchandising directives Leadership management: experience with attracting, developing, and motivating top talent, swiftly adapting to change and leading others through the change-curve, developing collaborative relationships with others, and leading and influencing a team Skills Proficient with basic technology (e.g., Point of Sale system, Microsoft Office programs, and Apple devices) Excellent written and verbal communication Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks Ability to react under pressure, use good judgment in ambiguous situations, and be flexible/adaptable SPECIAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS Work a flexible, full-time schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays Attend corporate business meetings and conferences WORKING CONDITIONS Continuous mobility throughout the store during shift, including twisting Frequent bending, pulling, pushing, stooping, reaching, and twisting during shift Frequent lifting and/or moving up to 25 lbs. during shift Continuous coordination and manipulation of objects during shift If an associate has a disability that prevents them from performing an essential function of the job, the Company will engage in the interactive process with the associate to determine whether there is a reasonable accommodation that will enable the associate to perform the essential functions of the job. The pay range for this position is $28.00 - $35.00 / Hour with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta ABOUT At Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful . Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services. jobs.description: Job Description Manager — Logistics Operations South Branch Location - Chennai The Manager — Logistics Operations is responsible for end-to-end warehousing and secondary transportation operations for the South Branch, ensuring products are stored and distributed efficiently while delivering required customer service levels at an optimized logistics cost . The role manages logistics operations across a multi-state network spanning approximately 5–6 states , covering the complete flow from storage at warehouses/CFAs through secondary transportation to distributors and customers . As a key branch leadership role , the position has significant responsibility for logistics cost, service, capacity and operational performance across both warehousing and transportation. Key Responsibilities Warehousing Operations Manage warehouse/CFA operations across the assigned geography, ensuring efficient storage and movement of goods. Support the identification, evaluation and setup of warehouses/CFAs based on business volumes, network requirements, service expectations and cost. Optimize warehouse capacity, layout, throughput, manpower deployment and operational productivity . Work closely with CFA/3PL partners to drive day-to-day operational performance and cost efficiency . Ensure appropriate inventory handling, hygiene, GMP and applicable food/product safety standards . Maintain operational readiness for internal, statutory, quality and global audits . Ensure adherence to applicable licenses, including FSSAI , regulatory requirements and operating procedures. Secondary Transportation Manage secondary transportation from depots/warehouses to distributors and customers across the assigned geography, covering approximately 200 vehicles across the region. Plan transportation capacity based on business volumes, demand patterns and service requirements. Manage multiple transporters/3PL partners and ensure appropriate fleet availability and deployment . Drive vehicle utilization, transporter performance, turnaround time and overall transportation efficiency . Optimize routes, loads and fleet deployment to improve productivity and control freight costs . Manage day-to-day transportation disruptions and ensure continuity of customer service . Cost & Service Optimization Own and manage key branch logistics costs across warehousing and transportation, including warehouse rentals, CFA costs, manpower, freight and transporter payments . Balance service, capacity and cost , ensuring customer requirements are met without compromising overall logistics economics . Analyze logistics costs and operational KPIs to identify cost leakages, productivity opportunities and areas for improvement. Partner with CFAs, transporters and 3PL providers on commercials, performance improvement and cost optimization . Projects, Innovation & Continuous Improvement Lead and support new logistics and warehousing projects , including network changes, new warehouse/CFA setups, transportation initiatives and operational transitions. Identify and implement innovative solutions to improve warehouse productivity, transportation efficiency, service levels and logistics cost . Drive continuous improvement through process redesign, automation, digital tools, data and new ways of working. Evaluate emerging logistics practices and technologies and assess their applicability to branch operations. Partner with central Supply Chain, Warehousing, Procurement and other teams to execute logistics transformation and productivity initiatives . Partner & Stakeholder Management Manage relationships with CFAs, transporters, 3PL partners and other logistics service providers. Support evaluation, onboarding and transition of new logistics partners. Partner closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance, Procurement, Quality and other internal stakeholders. Manage operational challenges across the multi-state network, ensuring timely resolution while balancing service and cost. Candidate Profile We are looking for a logistics professional with experience across secondary transportation, warehousing and distribution operations , ideally within a complex, high-volume distribution environment . Relevant Industries — In Order of Preference FMCG / Food & Beverages — strongly preferred Consumer Goods E-commerce Quick Commerce Modern Retail Other high-volume distribution-led businesses Prior FMCG/food experience would be advantageous. However, strong candidates from adjacent sectors with comparable logistics scale and complexity can also be considered. Experience & Capabilities The ideal candidate should bring: Strong understanding of secondary transportation and distribution logistics , preferably across a multi-location or regional network . Hands-on experience in transporter management, fleet planning, capacity management, vehicle deployment and transportation cost management . Good understanding of warehouse operations , including capacity, layout/design, manpower planning, throughput and productivity . Exposure to CFA/3PL operations and service-provider management . Understanding of warehouse compliance, GMP, audits and applicable statutory/regulatory requirements . Exposure to FSSAI/food safety requirements would be an advantage for candidates from food/FMCG environments. Strong commercial orientation and ability to understand logistics cost drivers and operational KPIs . Strong analytical and problem-solving capability , with demonstrated examples of driving operational improvements . Ability to manage projects and drive continuous improvement or innovation within logistics operations. Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills . Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment and respond quickly to operational disruptions . Qualifications MBA / PG Diploma in Supply Chain, Operations or Logistics preferred. Relevant experience and a strong operational track record will be equally valued. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
The Process Technician is responsible for building, installing, operating, and troubleshooting fluid and process systems at SpaceX’s power generation facility. This role focuses on plant fluid systems including fuel gas, ammonia, water, compressed and instrument air, and HVAC. Technicians play a key role in the design and commissioning process by providing feedback to engineers on how systems will be operated and maintained.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Support fuel gas, ammonia, water/cooling water, compressed and instrument air, HVAC, and related balance-of-plant process systems
Read and interpret planning documents, P&IDs, schematics, data sheets/manuals, drawings, blueprints, and engineering sketches
Adjust, repair, or replace faulty components of process, utility, and plant fluid equipment
Connect and verify pressure transducers, thermocouples, and other sensors
Complete necessary wiring of electrical support equipment for process and utility systems
Perform high-pressure liquid and pneumatic testing
Troubleshoot and repair high-urgency operational issues found during commissioning, start-up, outages, or normal plant operation of fluid systems
Follow lockout/tagout, hot work, confined space, and other site safety procedures while working on live and isolated process systems
Work with fluids, mechanical, and controls engineers to walk down systems, redline drawings, and improve operability and maintainability
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
High school diploma or equivalency certificate
3+ years of experience using mechanical and/or electronics hand tools
3+ years of experience with pipe fitting and fabrication
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Strong understanding of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
Experience maintaining and troubleshooting complex fluid and mechanical systems in a power plant, process plant, or similar industrial facility
Experience with fuel gas, ammonia, water treatment or cooling water, compressed/instrument air, HVAC, or hydraulic/pneumatic systems
Experience with orbital or structural welding
Experience with pneumatic/hydraulic system fabrication
Professional experience with calibrated measuring instruments
Experience using heavy equipment, including but not limited to overhead cranes, forklifts, and manlifts
Ability to read P&IDs and support system commissioning and outage work
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Must be able to lift at least 25 lbs (unassisted)
Must be willing to travel up to 25%. Position is based at a SpaceX power generation facility; work at other SpaceX sites for extended periods for similar work may be required
Must be able to climb ladders and work in confined spaces
Must be available to work overtime, weekends, and rotating shifts as needed based on plant operational needs; flexibility required
Ability to work in all environments (heat, cold, rain) while wearing appropriate PPE

With titles like Candy Crush, Candy Crush Soda Saga and Farm Heroes Saga, our code runs on hundreds of millions of devices across the world. We believe that the right tools in the right hands are key to our success as a company. If you want to boost productivity for the teams creating entertainment for millions of players to enjoy on the go then this is the right job for you. In the role of Game Engine Developer , you’ll be at the heart of our tech, evolving the cross-platform engine and toolchain that empowers hundreds of developers to build King’s world-class casual games. This role belongs to part of the Kingdom we call Shared Tech. The teams within Shared Tech work as B2B organizations working across all the technology that we use to power our live games, including data infrastructure, machine learning, payments infrastructure and the game engines themselves. The vision within Shared Tech is "We are the stage where King games love to perform”. You will be working in Shared Tech’s Game Production organization, where we focus on game-changing tooling and infrastructure to enable our content creators to build features faster, easier and more reliably. This includes working across multiple teams to facilitate both architectural decisions and hands-on development to support smaller feature teams based on rolling needs. You should have a broad range of knowledge and be able to context switch easily to provide active support across the whole team and beyond. The ability to see the project as a whole is crucial as you monitor the development in real- time to determine how we should support and assist the rest of the development team. You’ll also play a key role in improving our feedback loop, making it easier for teams to adopt tools and for our team to learn what’s working (or not). Strong communication and empathy for end users are essential. King is a place where we build features in the open, collaboratively. We value diverse opinions and make sure every voice is heard. We offer you the freedom and opportunity to work on fulfilling tasks and to continue your journey as an expert tools developer. Your role within the Kingdom You will enjoy a creative, challenging and collaborative environment where your ideas will be every bit as valued as your programming expertise. Some of your responsibilities include: Develop the game engine, refine new and existing features, and design, implement, and maintain in-house tools embedded directly within our products. Collaborate with various current and future users of our Game Engine, bridging various crafts within King with the intent to optimize, improve and discover workflows across games Deliver high quality and well-structured code Improve quality and performance inside our products landscape Share knowledge and best practices with peers and game teams Drive and support features adoption with stakeholders in the game teams across King Skills to Create Thrills You are a programmer who enjoys an array of challenges, and strives to deliver great products and technology. You are a self-starter, curious and a fast learner. You are excited to contribute to live games with a massive user base. You question the status quo and strive for effective innovations as much as you like maintaining and extending existing software. You enjoy being in contact with users of your tools and use their feedback to improve your work. We take pride in the tools that we deliver, and the team that builds them. We are looking for a new voice in this context and want to find someone who has the technical skills we need while also contributing to the team as a whole. We have prioritized trust and open communication as the cornerstone of our team culture. Finding the right mix of autonomy and support is another important aspect of work in this team. We enable this by making sure that information is shared effectively and prioritizing supporting each other when help is needed. We have chosen this approach since we believe in creating an environment that enables us to actively contribute to shaping the way we move forward. While also making sure that we, as a group, are aligned. This requires a sense of responsibility from us all, something which we are also proud of. We believe that in order to remain competitive we need to grow in our roles, we support this by investing time and effort into personal development continuously throughout the year. We also offer truly awesome benefits here at King in addition to a thriving social calendar of events for Kingsters to really get to know each other. We design games for everyone, no matter where they are or who they are, and we employ all sorts of people from all kinds of backgrounds to bring them to life. Truth is, we simply cannot expect diversity in our players and originality in our games without first nurturing it in our people. A great saga needs all sorts of heroes. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. jobs.description: Amazon Advertising Trust is on a mission to redefine how trust is enforced at internet scale, and we are looking for exceptional scientists to help lead the way. A day in the life - Ship a model into production, then find and document where it fails once real traffic reaches it. - Drive the technical discussion, inside your team and with partner teams, on how to close that gap. - Bring a fresh angle to a problem that is not yours and help a peer get further than they would have alone, building trust across the team in the process. - Mentor while staying hands-on.
